text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon was doing
joint training with Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: *pant, gasp*...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —Haha! A one-on-one showdown with Brian gets my blood pumping as always!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... Your spirit in facing me head-on
time and time again is utterly exasperating."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Well, I must say I'm impressed, though.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Having said that, neither Brian nor I
have shown anywhere near our best yet.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "How can I have an even hotter one-on-one duel and fire things up even more—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...I know! Let's think about "that thing"
we saw on TV the other day!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
See, it's that thing even pro athletes do
before a big match.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Um, curry roux... wait, no.
Root beer... no, not that either...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That's the one, Trainy!
Ahhh~, what a relief.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, Brian,
do you have a pre-race routine?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'd never really paid attention to it, but... you're right.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
If I had to mention anything, it would just be that
I clear my mind and concentrate before training or races.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh~, sounds great!
Teach me the trick too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
So we can have a fiery one-on-one.
Sounds good, right, Brian?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...It's a hassle, so only once, got it?
If we're doing this, I'd prefer somewhere quiet where I can focus.
And so, we moved to a mountain stream to learn the art of mental focus, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... Focus...!
Picture a serious match...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You're speaking your thoughts out loud, Ama-san.
You just need to calm your mind.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Nggghhh!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ugaaaah!!
My brain's gonna explode!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...This won't do.
choice_data_list: Maybe a different routine would be better.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: In that case, Trainer-pal! What kind do you think would suit me?
choice_data_list: Pumping myself up with a loud shout
Try consulting a book for reference

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's my specialty!
All right—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—Uoooooh!!
Let's have a heated one-on-one showdown—!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, feels just right!
I'm settling on this for my routine!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Heh.
Do you intend to do that every time we race?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
Look forward to our next match!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Still, focusing and shouting so much has left me completely starved.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Let's head back to the academy and grab lunch. Don't worry,
I've got Brian's share ready too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Ama-san.
There aren't any vegetables in this bento, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry. Even for a picky eater like you,
I made something totally delicious!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...In that case, I will have some.
Friends or rivals? I spent my lunch break together with the two of them and their curious relationship.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Mm?
What on earth do you mean by that...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I see. A book, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You said it yourself earlier, Ama-san.
Even pro athletes have their routines.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I think she meant we should try reading a book that covers things like that, though.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so...!
Then why don't we head to the library?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh~... Strike an original pose, touch the uniform—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
There are so many different kinds.
I can't decide which one to use as a reference!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...If you agonized that much over tests, you wouldn't be sweating over barely scraping past failing grades.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
S-Shut up! I don't wanna hear that from you,
Brian, when you don't even take studying seriously!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And yet, you always manage
to get decent scores anyway...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Just the bare minimum, yeah. If my grades are a total disaster,
Sis and the student council folks will never hear the end of it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Don't go ruining our next match by getting stuck in some
worthless supplementary lessons, alright? Ama-san.
Even through their test scores, a glimpse of their rivalry(?) could be seen...
